label: Bisulfite oxidation by oxygen
sourced_form: Multiply the R17/R17b pair by exp(a) at fixed equilibrium constant. The steady-state KHSO3 pool and its oxidation flux both respond.

label: KCl hydrolysis and reverse chlorination
sourced_form: Multiply both directions of R10 by exp(a), holding Kp fixed. The 1.7e8 m3 mol−1 s−1 chlorination rate enters the oxidative-drain term k17b O2/k10 in the steady-state hydrolysis balance.

label: KOH + SO₂ association falloff
sourced_form: Use k0*[M] = exp(a)*2.6e30*T^(−7.6)*[M] in m3 mol−1 s−1; k11=(k0[M])/(1+k0[M]/1e8). Recalculate the reverse dissociation by detailed balance.

label: Bisulfite intermediate stability
sourced_form: Decrease Hf(KHSO3) by a*5 kJ mol−1. Multiply R11 association Kp by exp(+5000a/RT) and R17b oxidation Kp by its reciprocal. Recalculate R11 reverse and R17b forward fluxes.

label: HCl-dependent suppression of hydrolysis
sourced_form: Add 7.5a ppm of persistent background HCl to R10 hydrolysis mass action. This spans 0 to 15 ppm over the search interval.

label: Reversible SO₂/SO₃ oxidation kinetics
sourced_form: Multiply both by exp[1000a(1/1273−1/T)]. The Arrhenius slope shifts by 1000a K while preserving the 1273 K rate; in the 1100 K pivot parameters add 1000a(1/1273−1/1100) to log frequency and 8.31446261815324a kJ/mol to apparent Ea.

label: KCl + SO₃ chlorosulfate association
sourced_form: Geometrically interpolate h0 to k13[KCl] with weight a/2. k13=(k0[M])/(1+k0[M]/kinf), k0=1.9e29 T^(−7.8) m6 mol−2 s−1 and kinf=1e8 m3 mol−1 s−1.

label: KOH + SO₃ bisulfate association
sourced_form: Add (a/2) k12 [KOH] to SO3 removal, with KOH from wet pseudo-steady state. Use low-pressure k0=2.6e30 T^(−7.6) m6 mol−2 s−1, kinf=1e8 m3 mol−1 s−1, and Lindemann interpolation.

label: Finite terminal bisulfate capture
sourced_form: Use h/(1+a*h/(k19[KCl]+k18[KOH])). Table 2 k19=3e7 and k18=1e8 m3 mol−1 s−1. This adds a concentration-dependent terminal waiting time.

label: Monomeric KCl availability
sourced_form: Use c_reactive=c_total f_m^(a/2), with f_m=2/(1+sqrt(1+8 Kp p_total/1 bar)) from 2 KCl ⇌ (KCl)2. JANAF gives log10 Kp = log10 Kf(dimer)−2log10 Kf(monomer); interpolate the tabulation against 1/T.

label: Sulfation of airborne solid KCl by SO₂
sourced_form: Sengeløv initial shrinking-core rate times 53.2 µm/r, evaluated with the current effective radius of airborne chloride, times accessible fraction a.

label: Sulfation of deposited KCl by SO₂
sourced_form: Apply the Sengeløv SO₂/O₂ rate to an exposed equivalent 53.2 µm chloride deposit grain; a varies accessible fraction.

label: Chloride coating of sulfate surfaces
sourced_form: Suppressed foreign-area fraction decays as a/S on supersaturated KCl. Pure chloride surfaces retain their original rates.

label: Interfacial salt uptake
sourced_form: Set common mass accommodation alpha=10^(−a), adding surface resistance to the original transition-regime uptake of each salt. The large-Knudsen limit falls in proportion to alpha.

label: Curvature-limited KCl growth
sourced_form: Interpolate planar and curved positive-only growth fluxes. Monomer saturation multiplies by exp(2σv/rkT); dimer saturation carries its square at fixed association equilibrium.

label: Curvature-limited K₂SO₄ growth
sourced_form: Interpolate planar and Kelvin-corrected positive-only sulfate flux. Use 2σv/rkT with the study bulk sulfate volume (2660 kg/m³) and Appendix D surface energy.

label: Dimer participation in KCl cluster formation
sourced_form: Only the dimer contribution to the critical cluster impingement flux loses fraction a. The collision term becomes p_m+√2(1−a)p_d, with the same equilibrium speciation, saddle and critical mass.

label: Wall-catalyzed SO₂ oxidation
sourced_form: Activate above 873 K. Bound the reversible relaxation by 4·3.66·D/d² for 25 mm diameter, with D=1.2×10⁻⁵(T/298.15)^1.75 m²/s. Fit the dimensionless effective utilization a.

label: Secondary condensed-phase sulfation
sourced_form: Reduce the impingement ceiling by diffusive resistance and by the chloride volume fraction as a proxy for exposed surface. Fit effective SO₃ capture probability a between zero and one.

label: Heat removal in sulfate cluster formation
sourced_form: Interpolate the original sulfate birth and the Feder factor b²/(b²+q²) at local vapor fraction, temperature, and supersaturation; nitrogen thermalizes clusters. Derive latent heat from Appendix D saturation pressure.

label: SO3 thermal dissociation
sourced_form: 2^a multiplies k1b=5.7e11 exp(-40000/T)[N2] s^-1 and its detailed-balance reverse.

label: Atomic oxygen abstraction by SO3
sourced_form: 3^a multiplies 7.8e5 exp(-3065/T) m3 mol^-1 s^-1 for SO3+O ⇌ SO2+O2 with the same equilibrium.

label: Competing SO3 + O abstraction barrier
sourced_form: Geometric interpolation from the 2006 flame-inferred R2 to Hindiyarti k=.028 T^2.57 exp[-122300/(RT)] m3 mol^-1 s^-1; reverse from equilibrium.

label: Falloff of oxygen atom association
sourced_form: Geometric interpolation to the Yilmaz RRKM N2 Troe association times Kc,diss; k_inf=3.7e5 exp(-850/T), k0=2.9e15 T^-3.58 exp(-2620/T), Fcent=.57 exp(-T/371)+.43 exp(-T/7442), SI mol/m3.

label: Gas-phase recombination of oxygen atoms
sourced_form: 2^a scales k3=1.2e5/T m6 mol^-2 s^-1; [M]_eff=[total]+14.4[H2O]; reverse from Kc for 2O ⇌ O2.

label: OH pair formation from water and O
sourced_form: 2^a multiplies 2OH ⇌ O+H2O, k=.0357 T^2.4 exp[2110 cal mol^-1/(RT)] in SI after conversion of cal to J; reverse by Kc.

label: Measured-range trace water in dry feed
sourced_form: Set water to 100+60a-10a^2 ppm (30–150 ppm, 100 ppm at zero); displace N2 and conserve elemental H throughout.

label: SO3 abstraction by OH
sourced_form: 3^a multiplies .048 T^2.46 exp[-114100/(RT)] m3 mol^-1 s^-1; reverse from thermochemistry.

label: HO2 recycling via atomic oxygen
sourced_form: 2^a multiplies k=2e7 m3 mol^-1 s^-1, with its thermodynamic reverse.

label: Mixed OH and HO2 radical termination
sourced_form: 2^a scales the sum of both duplicate GRI terms, 1.45e7 exp[500 cal/(RT)] + 5e9 exp[-17330 cal/(RT)] m3 mol^-1 s^-1, reverse by Kc.

label: Quartz-assisted oxygen atom recombination
sourced_form: First order 20a(T/1273)^1.75 s^-1 with return of 1/2 O2. The temperature dependence represents diffusive delivery to a reactive wall.

label: Prior effective reversible SO2 and SO3 exchange
sourced_form: a times the previously calibrated reversible SO2 oxidation law in parallel with explicit pathways; freeze the original training-only gas fit at log pivot=-5.1253641490 and delta Ea=114.45626480 kJ/mol (Ea total 177.45626480).

label: Delayed bisulfite oxidation
sourced_form: Use the same diversion, with R17b KHSO₃ + O₂ → KHSO₄ + O set by R17 and thermochemical reversal.

label: Chlorosulfate intermediate on the SO₃ branch
sourced_form: R13 adduct formation draws one KCl and one SO₃. Its R20 hydrolysis frequency uses 5% water and the Table 2 estimated rate.

label: Explicit KOH and chlorine exchange
sourced_form: Relax the actual KCl + H₂O ⇌ KOH + HCl pair toward the common chlorine balance using R10 kinetics and the 1-bar Table 1 equilibrium ratio.

label: KOH competition for sulfur dioxide
sourced_form: R11 Lindemann KOH + SO₂ (+M) association uses measured/inferred bath molarity and Chanpirak low/high-pressure limits.

label: KOH capture of sulfur trioxide
sourced_form: R12 Lindemann KOH + SO₃ (+M) → KHSO₄ competes with R11 for KOH and with the KCl capture pathway for SO₃.

label: Bisulfite redissociation and SO₂ return
sourced_form: R11b breakup calculated from R11 falloff and the equilibrium constant. KHSO₃ can break up or transform via R17b.

label: Chlorosulfate redissociation and SO₃ return
sourced_form: Reverse R13 calculated from its pressure-dependent association and equilibrium constant. Breakup competes with R20 and R21.

label: Bisulfate redissociation and SO₃ return
sourced_form: Reverse R12 via forward falloff and Table 1 thermochemistry. R12b, terminal capture and reduction share one KHSO₄ inventory.

label: Bisulfate reservoir before chloride capture
sourced_form: The same KHSO₄ routing uses estimated R19 KHSO₄ + KCl capture at 3×10⁷ m³/mol/s.

label: KOH competes with KCl for bisulfate
sourced_form: R18 consumes explicit KOH at the Chanpirak estimated rate and returns K₂SO₄ + H₂O. Competes with R19 for bisulfate.

label: Hydroxide attack on chlorosulfate
sourced_form: R21 competes with R20 hydrolysis for KClSO₃ and consumes actual KOH, forming sulfate + HCl.

label: HCl recombination on bisulfate
sourced_form: R20b KHSO₄ + HCl ⇌ KClSO₃ + H₂O uses the forward hydrolysis coefficient divided by the thermochemical equilibrium ratio.

label: Terminal R19 reversal by endogenous HCl
sourced_form: R19b gas K₂SO₄ + HCl → KHSO₄ + KCl uses thermodynamic reversal of the published estimated R19.

label: Terminal R18 reversal by water
sourced_form: R18b uses the original 5% wet bath and forward R18 divided by Kp. Gas-phase sulfate alone reacts.

label: Atomic oxygen reduction of bisulfate
sourced_form: R17 KHSO₄ + O → KHSO₃ + O₂ uses Table 2 rate and an imposed O mole fraction from 0 to 10⁻⁹.

label: OH oxidation of bisulfite
sourced_form: Rescale reverse R16 KHSO₃ + OH → KHSO₄ + H by 0–1 ppb imposed OH, using R16 and Kp.

label: Atomic hydrogen reduction of bisulfate
sourced_form: R16 KHSO₄ + H → KHSO₃ + OH with Table 2 barrier and 0–1 ppb imposed H.

label: R17b oxidation-rate uncertainty
sourced_form: Adjust the rate by exp(6000b/RT), an apparent activation energy perturbation of up to 6 kJ/mol.

label: R20 hydrolysis-rate uncertainty
sourced_form: Vary the R20-like water hazard by exp(6000b/RT).

label: R19 chloride-termination uncertainty
sourced_form: Adjust R19 on actual KCl and KHSO₄ by exp(6000b/RT).

label: Bisulfite association falloff
sourced_form: Apply 10^b to R11 low-pressure limit only and retain its published high-pressure ceiling.

label: Bisulfate association falloff
sourced_form: Apply 10^b to the R12 low-pressure limit, preserving the high-pressure ceiling and Kp.

label: Chlorosulfate falloff and refeeding
sourced_form: Scale only the underlying R13 low-pressure association limit by 10^b when computing breakup from Kp.

label: Bisulfite formation enthalpy coupling
sourced_form: Perturb KHSO₃ formation enthalpy by −3b kcal/mol. Forward R11 affinity and opposing R17b oxidation affinity respond in opposite directions.

label: Bisulfate formation enthalpy coupling
sourced_form: Perturb KHSO₄ formation enthalpy by −3b kcal/mol consistently in explicit R12b, R17b, R16b, R18b, R19b and R20b.

label: Chlorosulfate formation enthalpy coupling
sourced_form: Perturb KClSO₃ formation enthalpy by −3b kcal/mol in explicit R13b breakup and R20b HCl recombination.

label: Monomer selection for bisulfate capture
sourced_form: Interpolate between analytical KCl and the JANAF equilibrium monomer fraction for R19 attack on KHSO₄.

label: Shared dry-to-wet SO₃ supply
sourced_form: Replace that fraction with the fitted dry radical-supply law before competition for SO₃ by KCl and KOH. Use the wet bath in the wet calculation and preserve the supplier validity limits.
